_comment_Auth_CookieDomain: Registrable domain shared by the UI and this API (e.g. ".eplpredict.com"). Scopes the auth cookie to it and makes it SameSite=Lax. Only applied when this API is served from that domain; otherwise the cookie falls back to SameSite=None, which iOS Safari blocks.
_comment_AppBaseUrl: The site players visit (e.g. https://eplpredict.com), NOT the API host — emails link here. Deliberately not defaulted, like ApiBaseUrl: a default is inherited by every environment, and a prod URL as the default sends dev's emails to the live site. Unset means emails go out without the link rather than with a dead one.
_comment_ApiBaseUrl: Deliberately not defaulted. Set ApiBaseUrl per environment; the code throws if it is missing. A default here is inherited by every environment, and a prod URL as the default makes an unconfigured dev service point its score syncs at the live API.

GitHub._comment_Environment: Deliberately not defaulted — see ApiBaseUrl above. Set GitHub__Environment to 'dev' or 'prod' per service; it selects the EPL-{ENV}- job prefix and the target the dispatch workflow calls.

Email._comment_FromEmail: Deliberately not defaulted. Set Email__FromEmail per environment to an address on a domain you control and have verified with the provider; a default here is inherited everywhere and a placeholder domain is rejected at send time, after the API has already reported success.
Email._comment_Provider: Brevo unless set to 'Smtp'. Render blocks outbound SMTP, so Smtp is for local development only.
